title: Kyiv Claims to Have Regained Ground in Donbass Region
detail: Ukrainian military statements reported by Le Monde indicate that Kyiv claims to have regained ground in the Donbass region. The Ukrainian General Staff announced frontline advances in the eastern theater, though independent verification of the territorial gains remains pending.

title: Zelensky: Russia Shared Jet-Drone Technology with North Korea
detail: Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that Russia has shared jet-drone technology with North Korea, deepening concerns about Russia-DPRK military cooperation. The transfer of advanced drone technology to Pyongyang would mark a significant escalation in the military partnership between the two countries, which has already seen North Korean troops deployed to support Russian operations.

media.caption: Zelensky warns of Russia-DPRK military technology sharing
